command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== bamCoverage: per-base, unnormalised =="
bamCoverage -b reads.bam -o cov.bedgraph --outFileFormat bedgraph --binSize 1 --normalizeUsing None -p 1 > bc.log 2>&1

awk '$4>0{printf "%d\t%d\t%d\n", $2, $3, $4}' cov.bedgraph > got_cov.txt
INTEGRAL=$(awk '{s += ($3-$2)*$4} END{print s+0}' cov.bedgraph)
MAXD=$(awk '{if($4>m)m=$4} END{print m+0}' cov.bedgraph)
NINT=$(wc -l < got_cov.txt | tr -d ' ')
ALIGNED=$(awk '/aligned_bases/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="aligned_bases") print $(i+1)}' fixture.txt)
PROFILE_OK=no; cmp -s expected_cov.txt got_cov.txt && PROFILE_OK=yes

{
  echo "deepTools bamCoverage -- a coverage track checked against a constructed profile"
  echo "deeptools_version     $(bamCoverage --version 2>&1 | awk '{print $NF; exit}')"
  echo "aligned_bases         $ALIGNED   (10 reads x 100 bp)"
  echo "coverage_integral     $INTEGRAL   (assert == $ALIGNED -- CONSERVATION: every aligned base appears once)"
  echo "max_depth             $MAXD   (assert 5 -- the planted stack)"
  echo "nonzero_intervals     $NINT   (assert 5)"
  echo "profile_identical     $PROFILE_OK   (assert yes -- EXACT, whole track compared byte for byte)"
  echo "overlap_check         the 2049-2099 interval must read depth 4 (2+2), proving overlapping reads SUM rather than max-ing"
  grep -E '^2049' got_cov.txt | awk '{print "observed_overlap      " $0}'
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$INTEGRAL" -eq "$ALIGNED"
test "$MAXD" -eq 5
test "$NINT" -eq 5
test "$PROFILE_OK" = yes
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
